title: Custom icon, stronger filter security and miner blocking
message: Version 3.6.0 wires the branded icon into the extension, adds an optional known cryptomining-script blocklist, and hardens remote filter validation and download handling.
features: Branded extension icon for toolbar, popup and settings
Optional known cryptomining-script blocklist with its own setting
Reject overly broad or malformed remote filter rules
Limit filter download sizes and reject HTTP redirects
